name: The Super Egg-O-Matic

summary: At the control panel, Curgle Cranklehop's newest invention sputters wildly as hippogryph eggs go into the machine.

sections.title: A Machine of Curgle Cranklehop
sections.body: At its control panel, Curgle Cranklehop's newest invention sputters wildly. It takes a hippogryph egg found in the mountains of southern Feralas, around the Ruins of Isildien.

sections.title: What the Machine Does
sections.body: Place a hippogryph egg inside, and beeps and odd mechanical noises answer. The Eggometer weighs and measures the egg, then packages it in moments. What comes out is an Egg Crate, holding an egg of some variety.

faq.answer: Curgle Cranklehop built the Super Egg-O-Matic as her newest invention.

faq.q: What does the machine need to operate?
aliases: what do i give the egg-o-matic
faq.answer: The machine needs a hippogryph egg placed inside.

faq.q: Where do you find hippogryph eggs?
faq.answer: You find hippogryph eggs in the mountains of southern Feralas, around the Ruins of Isildien.
